summary: #edu407 I am glad Guided Reading works for you and your cousin. I wonder if you are having this success simply by teaching and reading with rather than your specific method...if that is the case then the method chosen doesn't matter if the success is there (just have fun too).
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: #edu407 I am glad Guided Reading works for you and your cousin. I wonder if you are having this success simply by teaching and reading with rather than your specific method...if that is the case then the method chosen doesn't matter if the success is there (just have fun too).
